title: Industrial Designer (Starlink)
note: Consumer hardware design for Starlink; requires 1+ year of ID experience and US-person status (ITAR).

facts.summary: Industrial designer creating Starlink consumer products from concept to production.
facts.duties: Ideate and prototype quickly, solve ergonomic and usability problems, deliver surface models and renderings, work with engineering through production.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's in a design discipline, 1+ years professional industrial/transportation design experience (3+ preferred), portfolio, NX/Rhino/SolidWorks; ITAR US-person requirement.
facts.apply: Apply on SpaceX's Greenhouse page with portfolio.
